title: Reject missing saved context and invalid whiteboard evidence publication
preconditions: Start with an existing board revision and valid saved evidence.

steps.action: Request element actions without a revision and with a nonexistent saved revision.
steps.expected_result: The requests return 400 and 404 respectively; missing saved context never substitutes the current revision.

steps.action: Attempt to publish using an outdated parent or a revision from a sibling board.
steps.expected_result: Publication is rejected; an author must reread the current board rather than overwrite its history.

steps.action: Attempt to publish a selection whose evidence ID is absent from its saved definition.
steps.expected_result: Publication fails instead of accepting an undeclared evidence selector for coverage.

expected_result: All defined steps retain exact context, report currency honestly and respect native element ownership.
